### Sign in with Google

You can now sign in to TradeSpace with your Google account instead of email/password. The login screen shows a Continue with Google button on installs that have Google OAuth credentials configured.

**Setup (one-time, ~5 min):** see docs/google-oauth-setup.md for the click-by-click walkthrough — create a Google Cloud project, copy Client ID + Client Secret into Windows User environment variables, restart TradeSpace.

**Account linking is automatic:**
- Brand-new Google user → account created with no password, sign in via Google going forward.
- Existing email account with the same Gmail → Google linked to your account on first successful sign-in. Both methods then work.
- Disconnect Google any time under Account → Security (refused if you have no password set, since that would lock you out).

### Database
Migration 16 adds users.auth_provider (default email) and users.google_id (NULL until linked, partial unique index).

### Setup tip
Without env vars set, the Google button is hidden and the email/password login is unchanged — fresh installs work out of the box.
